An investigation finds fossils of birds that show the humid past of the now semi-desert Geopark of Granada. What is now one of the driest areas in the south of the peninsula, millions of years ago was a garden that gave life to a diversity of fauna of which we are learning more thanks to the paleontological work carried out on the ground.
